'''Harsh Verma''' is an internationally recognized Principal Software Engineer in Artificial Intelligence at [[Palo Alto Networks]], enterprise AI architect, author, keynote speaker, and computer science researcher.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Org: Harsh Verma - Principal Software Engineer in AI at Palo Alto Networks |url=https://theorg.com/org/palo-alto-networks/person/harsh-verma |website=The Org}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Wikidata Entity Q139827028: Harsh Verma |url=https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139827028 |website=Wikidata}}</ref> He is an official member and columnist for the [[Forbes Technology Council]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Harsh Verma - Forbes Technology Council Profile |url=https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/people/harshverma/ |website=Forbes}}</ref> a Senior Member of the [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]] (SMIEEE), an elected Fellow of the [[British Computer Society]] (FBCS), an elected Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Arts]] (FRSA), and a Full Member of [[Sigma Xi]]: The Scientific Research Honor Society.<ref>{{cite web |title=Harsh Verma Invited Associations & Fellowships |url=https://www.harshverma.me/page-memberships |website=Harsh Verma Official Portfolio}}</ref>

Verma has authored two books on enterprise autonomous systems and cyber defense (''Beyond AI Engineering: From Creator to Curator'' and ''AI vs. AI: Engineering the Cybersecurity Counteroffensive''), served as technical reviewer for six AI and engineering books, published {{nowrap|27+}} peer-reviewed research papers across IEEE, Springer Nature, Oxford Academic, and international journals with over 150 academic citations,<ref>{{cite web |title=Harsh Verma Google Scholar Citations |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=zSt9oRMAAAAJ |website=Google Scholar}}</ref> and received {{nowrap|27}} international technology and leadership honors.

== Education ==
* '''[[Stanford University]]''' – Graduate Certificate in Artificial Intelligence & Executive Leadership (Stanford Center for Professional Development).
* '''[[University of Texas at Dallas]]''' (Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science) – Master of Science (M.S.) in Computer Science (Intelligent Systems & Distributed Computing).
* '''[[Uttarakhand Technical University]]''' – Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science and Engineering.

== Career and Executive Leadership ==
Verma serves as Principal Software Engineer (AI) at [[Palo Alto Networks]] in Santa Clara, California, where he architects autonomous multi-agent systems, deterministic AI security guardrails, and high-throughput enterprise cloud platforms.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Engineer Rewriting the Rules by Thinking AI Beyond the Code: Inside the World of Harsh Verma |url=https://nyweeklyjournal.com/blog/the-engineer-rewriting-the-rules-by-thinking-%E2%80%9Cai-beyond-the-code%E2%80%9D-inside-the-world-of-harsh-verma |website=New York Weekly Journal}}</ref> Earlier in his career, he engineered hyper-scale distributed backend platforms, real-time analytics pipelines, and deep learning systems at Hike Messenger, Reliance Jio (UT-Design), Worlds Enterprises, and Hypergiant Sensory Science.

In addition to his engineering leadership, Verma serves as an official contributor on the [[Forbes Technology Council]], Global Advisor at [[UC Berkeley SkyDeck]], industry awards judge for the Business Intelligence Group (BIG), Globee Awards, and Stevie Awards, and startup mentor for [[MassChallenge]] and ADPList.

== Authored Books & Technical Book Reviews ==
=== Authored Books ===
* '''''Beyond AI Engineering: From Creator to Curator''''' – ''Mastering the Human and Strategic Dimensions of Curating AI Systems'' (2025). A definitive treatise on transitioning from syntax generation to high-level system curation, covering multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, memory architectures, and the Super Engineer Trifecta. [https://www.harshverma.me/page-books Official Book Hub]
* '''''AI vs. AI: Engineering the Cybersecurity Counteroffensive''''' – ''Architecting Autonomous AI Defenses Against Intelligent Adversaries'' (2026). Examines adversarial machine intelligence and how enterprise security architects design zero-trust autonomous counteroffensive systems, behavioral invariants, and self-healing defense pipelines. [https://www.harshverma.me/page-books Official Book Hub]

=== Technical Books Reviewed ===
* '''''AI Ethics in Action (Technical Book Review)''''' – Expert technical review evaluating operational AI ethics, bias mitigation, and governance frameworks in production machine learning.
* '''''Hands-On AI Dev with Python (Technical Book Review)''''' – Technical review validating Python-based deep learning workflows, model serving, and scalable AI engineering patterns.
* '''''Leadership at the Helm of AI (Technical Book Review)''''' – Executive review assessing organizational AI readiness, C-suite governance, and enterprise AI ROI frameworks.
* '''''Python for Algorithmic Trading Cookbook (Technical Book Review)''''' – Technical validation of real-time market data pipelines, quantitative backtesting, and low-latency execution architectures in Python.
* '''''Machine Learning & Generative AI for Marketing (Technical Book Review)''''' – Technical evaluation of customer intelligence models, privacy-preserving personalization, and generative AI pipelines.
* '''''The TensorFlow Workshop (Technical Book Review)''''' – Technical review of deep neural network architectures, TensorFlow 2.x pipelines, and distributed model training.
